title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0373
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0373
Multiple Vulnerabilities in WordPress
Original Issue Date:July      21, 2026
Severity Rating: CRITICAL
Software Affected
WordPress versions prior to 7.0.2
Overview
Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in WordPress, which could allow an attacker to perform SQL injection attack, or execute arbitrary code on the targeted system.
Target Audience:
Users of affected WordPress versions.
Risk Assessment:
Risk of SQL injection attacks and remote code execution (RCE).
Impact Assessment:
Potential for unauthorized access, execution of arbitrary code, privilege escalation, and full compromise.
Description
WordPress is an open-source content management system (CMS) used to build websites and blogs.
Multiple vulnerabilities exist in WordPress due to a REST API batch endpoint route interpretation conflict (route confusion) and improper sanitization of the author__not_in parameter in WP_Query.
Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to perform SQL injection attack, or execute arbitrary code on the targeted system.
Solution
Apply the necessary patches and updates as provided by vendor:
https://wordpress.org/news/2026/07/wordpress-7-0-2-release/
Vendor Information
WordPress
https://wordpress.org/

title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0372
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0372
Multiple Vulnerabilities in TP-Link Products
Original Issue Date:July      21, 2026
Severity Rating: HIGH
Software Affected
TP-Link Kasa EC70 V4 firmware versions prior to 2.4.0 Build 20260520 rel. 4191
TP-Link Kasa EC71 V4 firmware versions prior to 2.4.0 Build 20260520 rel. 4191
TP-Link Kasa EC70 V4 firmware versions prior to 2.4.1 Build 20260621 rel. 76536
TP-Link Kasa EC71 V4 firmware versions prior to 2.4.1 Build 20260621 rel. 76536
Overview
Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in TP-Link products, which could allow an attacker on the same local network to disclose sensitive information, intercept encrypted communications through a Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attack, expose geolocation information, and compromise the confidentiality of the affected devices.
Target Audience:
All organizations and individuals using the affected TP-Link products.
Risk Assessment:
High risk of sensitive information disclosure, compromise of encrypted communications through Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attacks, and exposure of geolocation information.
Impact Assessment:
Potential for disclosure of sensitive information, interception of encrypted communications, exposure of geolocation information, and compromise of the confidentiality of affected devices.
Description
TP-Link Kasa EC70 and EC71 are smart security cameras that provide remote monitoring and surveillance capabilities for residential and enterprise environments.
These vulnerabilities exist in TP-Link products due to the use of a hard-coded cryptographic private key within the firmware and exposure of sensitive geolocation information through the local discovery mechanism.
Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to disclose sensitive information, intercept encrypted communications through a Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attack, expose geolocation information, and compromise the confidentiality of the affected devices.
Solution
Apply appropriate firmware updates as recommended by the vendor.
https://www.tp-link.com/us/support/faq/5192/
